_comment: C0-9 正文英译 · figma-mcp（2026-10-25）。无 extraSections（内置五节由 axes/leads/runs/unknowns/related 承载）。

axes.model_access:
**It calls no model itself** — an interface implementation called by MCP clients. It feeds Figma design context
(components, variables, layout data, Code Connect mappings) to coding agents so generated code matches the real design system.
axes.runtime:
**Two forms**: official hosted remote (mcp.figma.com/mcp — direct fetch 405 = exists but needs auth, officially recommended) +
desktop local server (127.0.0.1:3845/mcp, requires the desktop app + a Dev/Full seat).
The official docs state "strongly recommend the remote server".
axes.local_files:
In the desktop form it can download image assets into the project (Download assets setting, seen in the directly fetched official docs);
the remote form returns asset links. Design data lives in Figma's cloud.
axes.background: The remote form lives on Figma's side; the desktop form lives and dies with the desktop app. No background-task semantics.
axes.context: No server-side cross-session memory — design state lives in the Figma files themselves; Code Connect is a "design↔code" mapping layer, not memory.
axes.fit:
Fits: design-system-driven coding flows (the agent generates code from real components/variables), code↔canvas two-way flow.
Not a fit: clients outside the MCP catalog (needs the developer waitlist); teams wanting free canvas writes (plan gates).

mcp.transport:
**Streamable HTTP, two entry points**: remote mcp.figma.com/mcp (recommended) + desktop local http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp.
Verified: developers.figma.com docs fetched directly (2026-10-21); endpoint returns 405 (exists, GET not accepted).
mcp.auth:
First connection goes through Figma account login (OAuth semantics); no official docs for a plaintext-token configuration route.
The seat type (Dev/Full) determines the capability surface.
mcp.scope:
Read surface: design context, FigJam/Make, Code Connect; write surface: canvas create/update (plan + seat gates).
The client whitelist (catalog) is Figma's side access gate — the biggest difference between it and most MCP servers.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/mcp/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/mcp/_protocol.md).
unknowns:

related: Both connect agents to design/runtime: DevTools handles the browser runtime, Figma handles design-system context.
